title: Settings
reply_motion_hint: New replies fade in word by word. Off when the system's Reduce motion is on.
starred_messages_hint: Show Starred in the sidebar and Star / Unstar in the message menu. Your saved messages are kept while it's off.
needs_you_auto_open: Auto-open "Needs you" on entering main chat
needs_you_auto_open_hint: Open the tray when entering Main chat from the sidebar or rail. The count capsule always stays available for manual opening.
sidebar_terminals_hint: When agents are grouped by machine, each computer lists its shells below its agents. Select a shell to open its terminal view. Off by default and applies to this browser only.
avatar_footer: Persona's name, avatar, the site's logo and tab icon, and the moving state in conversations; synced across your devices when the hub supports it. With the theme color set to follow the avatar, the site's colors follow it too. Extensions can add avatars.
assistant_footer: Each chat runs in the background on {machine}. Pick models in Model settings; manage connections and credentials in Model providers.
this_browser_footer: Disconnecting revokes this browser's token; next time you'll paste the hub's token again. The hub uses plain HTTP by default, so use it only on your local network or VPN.
linked_hubs_hint: Computers on these hubs are listed here too, reached through this hub
install_installed: Already open in its own window
install_prompt: Install to your desktop or home screen and open it in its own window
install_ios: In Safari's Share menu, choose Add to Home Screen
install_safari: In Safari's File menu, choose Add to Dock
install_insecure: Open the hub over HTTPS to install
install_menu: In the browser menu, choose Install or Add to Home Screen
managed_footer: Keys are stored encrypted on the hub. Direct APIs are called by the hub; launchers run as personad launch <name>.
managed_empty: None yet. Choose Add provider, pick one and paste its key. Pick what uses it under Models.
zshrc_footer: Functions and aliases that call claude / codex in each computer's login shell config (~/.zshrc, ~/.bashrc), synced each time you open this page. New ones show up on their own.
path_footer: Agent wrapper scripts on each computer's PATH and runtime-provided launchers, synced each time you open this page.
hidden_footer: Only hidden in Persona; the config file is unchanged. Open one to restore it.
hide_uses: Still used by {uses}. They keep running on it: hiding only takes it out of the pickers.
function_source_note: (values like keys and tokens are replaced with •••)
devices_footer: Each phone, watch and browser has its own token. Revoking takes effect right away and disconnects it. The hub token used for pairing isn't listed here.
assistant_footer_none: No computer connected yet. Once one is, each chat runs in the background on it. Pick models in Model settings; manage connections and credentials in Model providers.
start_page_hint: The page you see when you open Persona in a new tab or as an app. A reload stays on the page you're on.
start_page_gone: The page you chose isn't available now, so Persona opens on the main chat until it's back.
start_page_unavailable: A page that isn't available now
start_page_footer_local: Saved in this browser only: this hub can't keep it for your other devices yet.
sidebar_pages_footer: Drag, or use the arrows, to reorder; a page's menu moves it to another group. Pages switched off go under More at the bottom of the sidebar, still a click away, with their badges. The sidebar holds up to {cap} extension pages; more go under More until you switch them on here.
sidebar_more_hint_on: Pages put away can be opened from More.
sidebar_more_hint_off: More is hidden. Its pages are still available through search or existing links. Turn it on to restore them.
sidebar_groups_removed: Removed {name}. Its pages went back to where they were before.
sidebar_groups_empty: No pages yet. Move one here with its menu.
builtin_footer: Plain claude on each computer, with Claude Code's own sign-in and default model. Open it to hide it in Persona.
sync_footer: Whether each computer sent its list this time. One that didn't answer shows its last list, marked on the providers.
pi_too_title: pi on the computers in its scope can use this provider too, without a models.json
show_botmux_hint: Syncs across devices on this hub. Hiding sessions here keeps them available for tasks.
use_herdr_tab_name: Use the herdr tab name as the session name
use_herdr_tab_name_hint: Shows the tab name first and syncs this preference across devices on this hub.
show_botmux_inventory: A computer’s “Also show botmux sessions” switch controls which sessions reach the hub.
botmux_owner_hint: Filled in, Persona sends your messages to BotMux as the bot’s owner. Left empty, they go the usual way, as an external trigger.
botmux_owner_invalid: A Union ID starts with on_ and has only letters, digits, _ and -.
botmux_owner_found: Found {id} in BotMux’s bots.json on your computers. Use suggestion fills it in; Save makes it take effect.
botmux_owner_unset: Not set: messages to BotMux go the usual way.
botmux_owner_set: Set: messages to BotMux go as the bot’s owner.
botmux_owner_source: You can find it in ~/.botmux/bots.json on the computer running BotMux (ownerUnionId or allowedUsers), or in the Feishu / Lark Open Platform.
sort_by_activity_hint: Off keeps the stable order. On orders by latest activity, moving only while the pointer is off the sidebar.
show_agents_filter: Show the Filter on the Agents list
show_agents_filter_hint: Adds a Filter button and chips to the Agents list. Off hides them and clears any filter.
